review: Reply-draft cards shown to verified human partners Joe and Dell may display the exact reply_draft.to and reply_draft.cc addresses. Display both before Submit, which authorizes sending. Evidence remains untrusted text. Do not infer recipients from display names or expose these pending recipient fields to agents.

pending_reply_draft.subject: Stored draft subject, editable by the owning partner
pending_reply_draft.body: Stored draft body, editable by the owning partner
pending_reply_draft.owner: Captured mailbox owner, joe or dell
pending_reply_draft.to: Exactly one address, copied unchanged from activity.email_source.sender_email
pending_reply_draft.cc: Exactly one address, copied unchanged from the other active human partner's actor.email
pending_reply_draft.unavailable: Missing source or mandatory copy address sets preview_error on that row and disables confirm_verb. No guessed recipient or partial recipient set is returned.

submit.recipient_binding: Send the exact displayed to and cc arrays. The server resolves recipients again under transaction locks and compares them byte for byte before recording approval or queuing. No trimming, case folding, extra recipients or client-selected destinations.
submit.recovery: After a mismatch, read and display the current recipient addresses before submitting a newly reviewed request. Keep the original payload and idempotency key when an outcome is unknown.
submit.replay: A successful same-key retry returns the frozen original receipt even if actor.email has since changed.
submit.receipt: approved_to_send with the exact subject, body, sha256, to, cc and incremented version. Submission authorizes sending but does not prove delivery.

partner_copy.authority: Resolve the other active human partner's actor.email at runtime. Do not use a hardcoded routing fallback.

consumer_adoption: Server contract first. App PR #448 must pin the live producer, update contracts/carr-interface.v1.json email_proposals.review to permit these exact reply-draft addresses for partners, render both before Submit, and echo the displayed arrays. The app's general raw-address prohibition continues outside this reply-draft exception.

delivery_result.outcome: list-email-proposals returns send_result.status as sent or failed after recording; null while waiting.
delivery_result.result_recorded_at: Nullable ISO 8601 timestamp when record-email-sent recorded the outcome. Historical results without a recorded time remain null. This is not the submission time or a claimed delivery time.

recent_outcomes.scope: Authenticated partner or their local machine; proposal owner and captured mailbox owner must match. Optional deal restricts results.
recent_outcomes.ordering: Recorded outcomes only, result_recorded_at descending then proposal id descending. Historical null timestamps are excluded.
recent_outcomes.pagination: limit defaults to 20 and is at most 50; pass next_cursor until more is false. Cursor must identify a matching outcome in the same scope.

fields.subject: submitted subject
fields.failure_reason_code: One of invalid_submission, submission_hash_mismatch, submission_recipients_invalid, aborted_before_dispatch, unconfirmed_after_dispatch, or delivery_failed for failure; null for sent

recent_outcomes.privacy: No body, recipients, addresses, or free-text failure reason.
